description: Recorded on a Chikyu fork by the t9 fork test for t19 (fee accrual, sell attribution and route-run rows): the money flow of two coins on Barkswap (Algebra Integral 1.2.1) with the audited MwzBark contracts. logs[] are every MwzBarkLauncher, MwzBarkPlugin and MwzBarkFeeSplitter log in order (raw topics/data plus args decoded with contracts/dogeos/barkswap/abi). steps[] are the transactions in order with the launcher's and splitter's book read-backs after each (strings are wei / coin units; four-element arrays are in bookOrder). routePlan is the operator's plan of the one route run (expectedPaid = routerPaid(splitter).amount after the claim; amounts inside the bands of splitter.pending()). Per coin, FeesCollected books apportion(received, pluginTotals - previous collectedTotals); CoinFeesConverted draws coinsIn / pending from every pending book (spec D1: every pending sell row converts by that fraction at nativeOut / coinsIn). Accounts are hardhat's well-known local test accounts (fork only).
